chunks: And Al-ʿAlāʾ narrated from Muḥammad ibn Muslim, from one of the two Imams, peace be upon them, who said:
I asked him about the vessels of the People of dhimmah.
He said: “Do not eat in their vessels if they eat in them carrion, blood, and the flesh of swine.”

key_terms.آنِيَةِ: vessels or utensils used for eating and drinking
key_terms.أَهْلِ الذِّمَّةِ: non-Muslim protected communities living under covenant
key_terms.الْمَيْتَةَ: carrion, an animal dead without lawful slaughter
key_terms.لَحْمَ الْخِنْزِيرِ: the flesh of swine, which is haram

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to eat from the vessels of Ahl al-Dhimmah if they use them for carrion, blood, or pork?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the use of the vessels of Ahl al-Dhimmah. It prohibits eating in their vessels when those vessels are used for impure and haram substances such as carrion, blood, and pork.
